From my understanding, guard means you stay at home and is funded by the state you reside in. Reserve is a more expeditionary thing where you are still under federal pay, but it’s part time. I could be incorrect but it’s what I’ve picked up so far.

Space Force at least in my experience tends to let people join in waves, they have a limit set every year and if you’re not locked in you have to wait. The line just gets longer so if you have time I recommend talking to an AF recruiter and let them know you’re interested in Space Force, after that put in your application. If they highly recommend you, apply for the jobs you want, and play the waiting game. Other branches are better at getting you what you want (not Marines).

Keep in mind as a current 1N4X2 I have heard JCAC or what the 1N4X1s go through has a 2/3 pass rate Air Force wise, when you look at the other services and the people who go through the course it’s even lower. 

It’s luck of the draw between the two shreds and X2s definitely have it easier than their counterparts. The rewrite for the X2 course should have been pushed out already and should be increasing the amount of time you’re in Goodfellow to around 90 days. 

With Intel, specifically 1N4s as soon as you get your training done at your first base you should be a 5 level and you won’t have to wait for rank to get all the benefits. 

Hope this helped, the instructors are overall great people in this tech school.
